title: My Burger Bistro
description: Run your own bustling 3D burger restaurant—flip patties, serve sizzling orders, collect cash stacks, hire staff, and expand counters and seating.
controls: Drag anywhere on screen with the virtual joystick to move your chef, pick up freshly grilled burgers, serve customers, collect cash, and unlock upgrades.

zh-CN.title: 我的汉堡餐厅
zh-CN.description: 超上头的 3D 模拟经营汉堡店：亲自端盘上汉堡、疯狂收钞票、雇佣员工扩建餐桌和出餐台，把小店干成爆满连锁餐厅！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕拖动虚拟摇杆控制店长移动，自动取餐、上菜、收钱并踩上解锁区升级扩建店铺。
